_comment: Environment asset recipe. `node tools/assets/env/build.mjs [step...] [--only id,...]` regenerates public/assets/env/ from assets-src/ (see tools/assets/sources.json); steps: sky, textures, water, props, manifest, previews, check. `node tools/assets/env/check.mjs` validates the output.

_fields.sky.hdri[]: id, src (.hdr), mood, clouds (true: extract a cloud layer), cloudsEvidence (render the rejected attempt as a preview), cloudsVerdict (why no layer), stars (true: extract a star layer), credit {author, url}
_fields.sky.flattenBelowDeg: [start, end]: the 2K background fades to a per-row mean between these elevations
_fields.textures.sets[]: id, source, credit, maps {albedo, normal (OpenGL), arm | ao + roughness}, sizeM [u, v] metres per repeat, sizeSource, why, notes, calibrate ({meanLinear, neutral} or {meanLinearRGB}), sizes (overrides textures.sizes)
_fields.procedural: seed and per-texture size / tileM (metres per repeat) for the generated water textures
_fields.props[]: id; src (.gltf/.glb read directly; .fbx/.obj/.dae/.blend/.usd converted by blender/convert.py); credit {author, url}; texture (max texture size, 512 small / 1024 large); scale; rotateY (degrees, to turn the front to +Z); pivot ('base' default = base centre, 'origin-y' = keep source y = 0 (waterline), 'wall' = x centre, bottom, back plane); pivotFrom [node names to compute the pivot from]; variants {name: [source node names]} (one child node per variant, layout kept); parts {name: [source node names]} (separate movable children under lod0); lod0MaxTris (default 15000, simplified above it); lod1 (true/false to force; default: when lod0 > lod1Above = 10000); lod1Ratio (default 0.3); dropAttributes ['COLOR_0', ...]; materials {sourceName: {rename, alphaMode, baseColor, roughness, metallic, dropTextures [baseColor|metallicRoughness|normal], alphaFromBaseColorTexture}}; screen {material, planarUV}; notes

sets.sizeSource: estimate: ambientCG publishes no dimensions for Ground093C; set from the scale of the wind-eroded ripples
sets.why: Chosen over Poly Haven coast_sand_01: Ground093C is the warm cream sand of the palette, while coast_sand_01 is brown and gravelly with debris.

Source albedo is very dark (mean linear 0.11) and reads olive-grey next to sand_dry; it is scaled per channel to sand_dry's mean colour x 0.4 (wet sand is roughly 40-50% as bright as the same sand dry), keeping its variation, so the shoreline blends from dry to wet without a hue jump. Remove `calibrate` in config.json to get the source colours back.

sets.sizeSource: estimate: ambientCG publishes no dimensions; 4 x 4 square slabs per tile, read as standard 50 cm pavers
sets.why: Chosen over Poly Haven interlocking_concrete_pavers: large neutral square slabs read cleanly from a high camera and sit with the cream/pastel palette and terrazzo; the interlocking set is a busy red-brown diamond pattern that reads as a driveway.

props.notes: Source is modelled about 2.2x too large (65 cm wide); scaled by 0.46 to a 30 cm wide 1990s notebook. The screen is its own material `screen` (dark, no texture) with planar UVs 0..1 (u to +X, v = 0 at the top) so the client can make it emissive or map a texture.
Six ground-planted clumps (no pot), 0.3-0.5 m tall. Alpha-masked, double-sided leaves.
Five ground-planted clumps (no pot), up to 0.42 m tall. Alpha-masked, double-sided leaves.

_shipping: Only what the client uses ships: the sky is drawn by a shader (no HDRIs), each texture set at the one size the client samples, the ocean normal map, and the props the buildings place. Add an entry back here before using it.
